# Deadname gate patterns, stored as salted hashes so this public repo never
# contains the words themselves. See .github/scripts/deadname-scan.mjs.
#
# To add one:  node .github/scripts/deadname-hash.mjs   then paste the line here.
# Matching is whole-word, so ordinary words that merely contain a pattern as a
# substring (the classic false positive) are correctly ignored.
#
# salt: 6e4d93d612a7a7b4a2f8a47e4022e13c
